annotations.title: Check a plan against retained corridors

description: Does the proposed treatment or harvest plan break or pinch a link between core areas? Returns pass, fail or incomplete, naming each unit that breaks a link. Give exactly one of package, path or example.

example.description: Name of a bundled example from list_examples.

include_geometry.description: Include GeoJSON geometry in the answer (default false).

package.description: A DFM Landscape Package v1 (dfm_package "1.0", WGS84 GeoJSON layers). See https://dendriticforest.com/data-format/

path.description: Path to a Landscape Package .json file on this machine (read, never written).

name: check_plan
title: Check a plan against retained corridors
